proposals.old: The {tactic}`try` combinator allows tactics to fail.
proposals.new: The {tactic}`try` combinator swallows a tactic's failure.
proposals.why: "Allows tactics to fail" is loose -- try doesn't make failure acceptable in general, it turns one failing tactic into a no-op so the enclosing proof can continue. "Swallows the failure" also matches the wording already used in the code comment right below this blurb.
